chunks: From him, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah al-Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ: Sama'ah ibn Mi'nan, a prominent narrator of the Imams
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Similar to it / Like it, indicating a repeated or parallel narration

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'mithluhu' indicate in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This concise narration from al-Kafi demonstrates the rigorous chain of transmission (isnad) characteristic of Shia hadith literature, linking Imam al-Sadiq (AS) through Sama'a through the narrator 'Anhu. It reinforces the legal consistency regarding the crime of slander (qadhf) by confirming the identical ruling of the preceding hadith, thereby emphasizing the reliability of the transmitted knowledge within the chapter's thematic focus.
